BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   D. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   C. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   B. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Money as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   C. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   D. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   B. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   C. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .

10. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   C. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Global Influence in Business 3.1 Public and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Consumer Satisfaction; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
